test_suite: Stripe Lifecycle & Entitlements Acceptance Suite (Priority A / Sandbox)

scenario_01_starter_subscription.details: Starter 4.90 EUR verified: 20 monthly units granted, successfully decremented to 19 after conversion.

scenario_02_pro_subscription.details: PRO 29.00 EUR verified: unlimited quota, multi-upload capability enabled, batch conversion succeeded.

scenario_03_lifetime_license.details: Lifetime 89.00 EUR one-time payment verified: source_type one_time, unlimited quota, valid_until None.

scenario_04_subscription_renewal.details: invoice.paid successfully renewed subscription, valid_until extended to 2026-10-16T12:10:25.

scenario_05_payment_failed.details: invoice.payment_failed transitioned subscription to past_due; PRO access revoked immediately.

scenario_06_cancel_at_period_end_grace.details: cancel_at_period_end=True keeps PRO active until valid_until; conversions permitted during grace period.

scenario_09_signature_security.details: Missing signature and forged HMAC signature rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

scenario_10_idempotency_replay.details: Duplicate webhook delivery recognized by stripe_event_inbox and returned status already_processed (HTTP 200).

scenario_11_out_of_order_resilience.details: Stale subscription.updated received after cancellation was safely ignored; subscription remained canceled.

scenario_12_anti_tampering.details: Unknown Price ID, non-EUR currency (USD) and mismatched amount (100 vs 2900 cents) all quarantined with 0 paid privileges granted.

scenario_13_multi_tenant_isolation.details: Tenants strictly isolated by tenant_id. Cross-tenant entitlement leakage impossible.

scenario_14_s01_strict_amount_currency_m.details: 0 amount, omitted amount, negative amount, missing currency, and mismatched mode/plan all quarantined with zero privilege escalation.

scenario_15_s02_late_checkout_no_revive.details: Late checkout.session.completed event cannot revive a canceled subscription. Entitlement remains safely revoked.

scenario_16_s03_out_of_order_permutation.details: Equal timestamps Permutation A (paid -> payment_failed at created=100): active status and valid_until deterministically preserved.

scenario_17_s03_out_of_order_permutation.details: Equal timestamps Permutation B (payment_failed -> paid at created=100): transitions to active and conversion succeeds.

scenario_18_s03_valid_until_monotonicity.details: Strict forward-only valid_until guarantee verified: older period invoice cannot roll back expiration date.

scenario_19_s04_subscription_updated_unk.details: subscription.updated with unknown price ID immediately stripped plan_code and quarantined entitlement (no old privileges inherited).

scenario_20_s04_mode_mismatch_on_update.details: subscription.updated with non-recurring price quarantined immediately.

scenario_21_starter_quota_renewal_bounda.details: Starter 20 units exhausted -> 429 verified -> invoice.paid renewal extends billing cycle -> quota resets to 20 statements -> conversion succeeds.

scenario_22_variable_period_lengths.details: Variable periods (7-day initial proration and 28-day Feb period) verified: authoritative bounds respected without fake 30-day override, quota resets cleanly.

scenario_23_delayed_checkout_delivery.details: Delayed checkout delivery verified: early invoice.paid pre-provisions entitlement, late checkout links tenant cleanly without overriding authoritative period.

scenario_24_duplicate_invoice_same_perio.details: Duplicate/adjustment invoice for the same period verified: current_period_start is preserved and quota usage is NOT arbitrarily wiped out.

scenario_25_stale_invoice_no_mutation.details: Stale invoice with PRO price cannot mutate active Starter subscription: plan, status, period and quota remained untouched.

scenario_26_provisional_access_bounded_d.details: Provisional access is strictly bounded in time: valid_until is never None, is_provisional=True tracked, and expired access drops to trial.

scenario_27_early_invoice_policy_and_ten.details: Early invoice satisfies full catalog amount/currency/period validation (S01); unauthorized cross-tenant rebinding is strictly blocked and quarantined.

scenario_28_payment_failed_after_subscri.details: payment_failed for renewed period is correctly enforced even when subscription.updated advanced calendar dates: separate paid_through ensures failure is not ignored and PRO privileges are revoked.
